_doc: CLAY TAXONOMY — the data point → surface → tier mapping, in one file.
Two consumers render this and neither carries its own copy:
scripts/clay_plan.py               the printed call plan and tier map
Until 2026-08-19 the script and the md each held the mapping and had
drifted in four measured places: a Headcount Growth row the md's tier
table lacked, the filing caveat on Annual Revenue and Latest Funding the
script lacked, the O3 mapping for Open Jobs the script lacked, and a C1
timeline mapping for Recent News the md never asserted. Each resolved to
the richer or conditional side, recorded here.
The tier follows the underlying SOURCE, not the tool, and getting it
wrong changes the score. `data_points` order is load-bearing: STEP 2 and
STEP 4 of the printed plan list dataPoints in this order.
`tier_condition`, where present, is part of the tier: the band holds only
when the condition does, and a value that fails it is an inference.

data_points.name: Tech Stack
data_points.note: A machine technographic scan is T1, never T4. Filing it at T4 caps the capability at L2.5 and silently suppresses the score — the commonest misclassification in the corpus.

data_points.name: Annual Revenue
data_points.tier_condition: when a filing is behind it
data_points.note: Filings and disclosures. For an entity that files nothing, this value is usually modelled and has no traceable source — that is an inference, not a T1 fact, and the tier follows the source as it does everywhere else.

data_points.name: Open Jobs
data_points.note: The posting is first-party; the aggregator is not. Hiring is the cheapest capability signal there is.

data_points.name: Latest Funding
data_points.tier_condition: when a filing is behind it
data_points.note: Filings and disclosures. For an entity that files nothing, this value is usually modelled and has no traceable source — that is an inference, not a T1 fact, and the tier follows the source as it does everywhere else.

data_points.name: Find Thought Leadership
data_points.note: T2 for a first-party publication or named conference; T3 for trade press.

custom_rule.name: Any Custom data point
custom_rule.tier: Tier of whatever it returns — read the source before assigning

gaps.leadership: Custom: board and executive committee membership
gaps.techstack: Custom: platform migrations announced in the last 24 months
gaps.thought: Custom: conference appearances and published bylines
gaps.news: Custom: regulatory filings and enforcement mentions
